finding: A two-operation hosting membership batch loses its response at the HTTP write deadline while changes subsequently commit
limits: Observation only: native UI calls were not delayed, intercepted, modified or automatically replayed.

The 502 body is unreadable to page JavaScript because that edge response lacks ACAO; CDP retains the exact native POST, status and selected response headers plus failure metadata. No body was invented.
One fresh 390px failed batch at 31.032s, one desktop passing batch at 26.502s; timing conditional, not a viewport-causal claim.
Both memberships were confirmed committed at 11:02:14Z, later than the network failure; their exact commit times and individual resolver durations are unmeasured.
No origin logs or deployed Go patch version inspected; HTTP-budget attribution follows the current source and matching timing.
